# Vendored Chrome (zipped)

Place Chrome for Testing zip archives here. The build script unzips the correct one.

Required files:

- `chrome-win64.zip` — for Windows builds
- `chrome-linux64.zip` — for Linux builds

Download once from https://googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing/ and drop the zips in this folder.

No external download happens during `npm install` or `npm run build`.
